summary: Frontend-only round 4 (Playwright, 4 runs, public URL). Validated: (1) ZERO removeChild/NotFoundError/insertBefore/'same key' DOM errors across every flow (login premium desktop+mobile 375px, dashboard, pendentes, new-charge dialog open/close x2, import ERP dialog open/close x2, real PDF import into import.teste with dedup, charge detail, WhatsApp + Email modals, timeline, negociacao, recebidos, relatorios, configuracoes, equipa, perfil, logout); (2) White Label logo is a real (naturalWidth=200) in both sidebar (company-logo-img) and dashboard top (dashboard-logo); (3) brand color switch to #D97706 applies to --brand, primary buttons, active nav item, accents and persists across reload — REVERTED to #2563EB and re-verified; (4) 'Últimas 5 Ações' card renders 4 activities (all that exist in DB) with type icon + summary + debtor name + timestamp; (5) KPI regression exact match. Only remaining defect: the Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning is STILL logged on every dashboard paint (was claimed fixed).

issues: NOT FIXED: Recharts console warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' still fires 2x per dashboard mount (reproduced in all 4 runs). The mount-gate did not solve it — ResponsiveContainer still measures before layout. Fix: give the wrapper an explicit pixel height/width or pass minWidth={0} minHeight={208} / debounce=1 to ResponsiveContainer

Layout: the 'Antiguidade da Dívida Pendente' card is as tall as the debtor table (~600px) but the chart only uses the top h-52 (208px), leaving ~250px of dead space; bars are tiny (max value 1). Consider letting the chart fill the card height

rca_of_the_issue: Recharts warning: the aging chart is inside a fixed h-52 wrapper but ResponsiveContainer is measured on the first paint before the flex/grid parent has resolved its width, so it reports -1/-1 twice. Gating the render on mount does not help because the measurement still happens in the same frame as the first layout; supplying explicit minWidth/minHeight or a numeric height (or debounce) removes the warning.
